question: How does a company apply for permission to put up a mobile tower or lay optical fibre in Maharashtra?
gold_answer: Fresh applications go through the GatiShakti Sanchar portal (gatishaktisanchar.gov.in), per the telecom infrastructure policy GR of 04-11-2022 (forest department applications excepted; regularisation of existing infrastructure through the Mahasanchar portal). Earlier, the 03-03-2018 circular had applications filed in hard copy with local authorities until the DGIT single-window portal was ready

gold_grs_detail.title: Action related to the establishment and maintenance of Tele-communication Infrastructure in the state till implementation of online portal.

product.answer: I couldn't find a GR on this in the corpus. The 2019 GR (08-07-2019, Inclusion of IP-1 Institutions in Telecom Infrastructure Policy) cites the missing 2018 GR (03-03-2018) in its preamble, stating that the 2018 GR fixed the policy for construction and maintenance of telecommunication infrastructure and that applications were to be accepted in hard-copy form until the online portal became active.

A copy should also be sent by email to mahatip@maharashtra.gov.in. I couldn't find a GR on this in the corpus.

product.answer: A company applies for permission to put up a mobile tower or lay optical fibre through the GatiShakti Sanchar Portal for new applications, and through the Mahasanchar Portal for regularization, as per the Telecom Infrastructure Policy dated 04-11-2022. Earlier, applications were to be submitted in hard copy to local authorities until the online portal became operational, under the 2018 policy dated 03-03-2018. No newer GR in the corpus changes this procedure.

product.answer: A company must apply in hard copy form to the concerned competent authority for permission to put up a mobile tower or lay optical fibre cable until the online single window portal is activated, and a copy must be sent by email to mahatip@maharashtra.gov.in. Earlier, the policy dated 17.02.2018 governed the permission process.

cited.title: Action related to the establishment and maintenance of Tele-communication Infrastructure in the state till implementation of online portal.
